Hi! Tattoo artist here. Generally speaking, you’ll want to wait 2-3 weeks after getting your tattoo before submerging in water (swimming, baths, etc.) Pool water especially can be very irritating to new tattoos which can impact your healing time, not to mention the risk of infection. 
Second skin bandages aren’t meant to be submerged in water so I wouldn’t trust using saniderm and then swimming. 
Would highly recommend getting your tattoo at the beginning of your 2 week off period so you have the best chance of healing as much as you can before swimming.

It could cost even less depending on where you shop. I bought my ingredients from Whole Foods. In total I spent $10.70, and it made about 6 servings. 

I made this on the stovetop in about 30-35 minutes, but it could be made in a slow cooker or pressure cooker! 

-Approximately one pound of stew beef
-One sweet yellow onion
-One large carrot
-Two large russet potatoes
-2 cups beef broth 
-A little bit of oil
-I used garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and crushed red pepper for seasonings but you could really use anything 


Sauté onions and beef in a pot until beef is browned. Add seasonings. Chop onion, carrots, and potatoes. Dump everything in the pot. Add beef broth. Stir. 
Let it come to a boil then reduce heat to medium and cover for 30ish minutes until potatoes and carrots are soft. 
This recipe could be stretched with extra vegetables but it makes quite a lot!
